tokens: Cyclic repetition of original10001-token held-out stream, truncated to each total capacity; final128 IDs are teacher-forced outputs. Repetition is a controlled numerical stress workload, not a natural long-document capability claim.

quality.argmax_changes: Record both winners, logits, reference margin and full-vocabulary max/RMS error. Investigate changes; no tolerance tuning.
quality.scope: Focused long-context regression against same selected weights/reference attention. Does not replace unchanged10000-target FP32-relative loss and100-case task gates or establish general long-context task ability.

other_original_matrix_rows.scope: Exploratory regression screen; investigate regressions before acceptance; no tail or strong ranking claim.

long_measurement.scope: Expensive boundary qualification with raw descriptive timing, no accepted speedup ranking from this sample count.

profile.scope: Completed encoder and command timing; report counter interference separately from ordinary timings.
profile.fraction_definition: Per sample, union of Online attention GPU intervals divided by the matching completed decode command GPU duration; median across three profiles at the same named depth. No host-wait or calibration-bracket denominator.
profile.reuse_policy: First profile prepares the exact prefix. Subsequent profiles set the same prefix and recompute the final decode input using valid exact-prefix cache reuse; each finishes at the same committed named depth. Record actual reused/prefill counts.

kv_decision.rule: Retain FP16 if every selected capacity fits complete6GiB admission/native charge and Online attention median contribution at maximum depth is no more than20% of completed profiled decode command time. Otherwise investigate capacity/traffic and consider separately versioned I8.
kv_decision.interpretation: Predeclared experiment decision rule; stage time is not a direct KV traffic measurement.

application_memory: Additionally qualify each selected Online model with an actual tokenizer-owning interactive CLI at maximum accepted depth,128 outputs ignoring EOS, complete application admission and owned native charge. No natural long-document capability claim.
